_doc: QC-PLAN-F4A (COORD RULING QC-PLAN-F4A): F4A column-SRAM vmr / rp1 kits on the F4A plan delta (candidate_qc_f4a_1026.json, apply_qc_f4a_1026.py): plan pins (cores/su/f4a), F4A spec (column SRAM view, track-snapped sites from results/qc_plan_f4a/geo/*_f4s.geo.json), MIF0 (module defaults).

rtl_patches.why: OWNER DECISION 13 hard-core reset contract: rst_n is a SYNCHRONOUS registered input at the data IO budget; the internal async 2-flop synchroniser (rl0/rl1 or rs0/rs1, async clear on rst_n) becomes a synchronous 2-stage relay of the same release depth (assertion synchronous, release cycle unchanged). Downstream flops keep their async clear from the relay output (timed recovery/removal).
edits: always @(posedge ck or negedge rst_n) if (!rst_n) begin rl0 <= 1'b0; rl1 <= 1'b0; end else begin rl0 <= 1'b1; rl1 <= rl0; end

always @(posedge ck) if (!rst_n) begin rl0 <= 1'b0; rl1 <= 1'b0; end else begin rl0 <= 1'b1; rl1 <= rl0; end   // QC-CORES kit patch (OWNER DECISION 13): rst_n = synchronous registered input; 2-stage synchronous relay, same release depth

reg [7:0] pvm_we1; always @(posedge ck) pvm_we1 <= vm_we;   // QC-CORES kit patch (face_guard: ONE pin register per input bit)
    wire [9:0] pwin [0:5];
assign pwin[gk] = {pvm_we1, pvm_waddr[23:22]};   // QC-CORES kit patch: was 6 kff replicas loading the same pins (face_guard shared 10); same cycle, bit-exact

qfd_dv_s8x_vmr_f4a._why_face: face_guard post-synth FAIL shared 10 (vm_we[7:0], vm_waddr[23:22] loaded by 6 kff replica pin registers + pvm_waddr): replicas replaced by one pin register each (0 cycles, bit-exact register merge).
